sources.title: Console Command List - Valve Developer Community
Left 4 Dead 2 Complete Console Commands (in-game command dump)
L4D2 Cvar List (cvarlist dump from the game)
steam-condenser issue #94 - L4D2 rcon status output with STEAM_1:0: ids

notes: Standard Valve Source RCON over TCP on the SAME port as the game's UDP port (default 27015, set with the -port launch argument; cvar hostport). RCON is enabled purely by setting rcon_password in server.cfg - there is no separate enable switch, so enableSetting is null. banid takes the duration FIRST, in MINUTES, with 0 meaning permanent; the trailing literal 'kick' makes it also drop the player immediately. banid and removeid only change the in-memory ban list - run writeid afterwards to persist to banned_user.cfg, or the ban/unban is lost on restart. kickid's message is free text and must NOT be quoted (quotes are sent literally); it accepts either the numeric userid or the STEAM_ uniqueid, so kick and ban are driven by the same identifier. status output lines look like: #250 1 "MorgueFish" STEAM_1:0:117097 11:02 92 0 active 25000 89.15.76.143:27005 - older builds print a single leading number instead of two, so the line pattern accepts either. Bot rows carry BOT instead of a Steam ID and are deliberately excluded, since bots cannot be banned by Steam ID. No motd command exists: the MOTD is the motd.txt file in the game directory, so commands.motd is omitted. Disagreement: hosting-provider docs (ZAP-Hosting, BisectHosting) document only 'kick <playername>', which moderates by NAME and would not match the Steam ID that banid needs; the game's own command dump lists both kick (by name) and kickid (by userid or uniqueid), and kickid is used here. Game directory is left4dead2 (srcds -game left4dead2).
